notes.title: Dashing is no longer janky!
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
You can now cancel your dash by moving in the opposite direction to the one you dashed in
Dashing will no longer continuously move you forwards after letting go of all movement buttons

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed bug where you'd bounce in opposite direction after bumping into a wall
Fixed bug where you'd be stale in the air after clipping an object and try to move in the same direction

notes.title: Twilight (New Extra) & Player Customisation
notes.content:
[u][b]Twilight - New Extra[/b][/u]
[b]Twilight [/b]introduces a new challenge whilst keeping the core mechanics of gameplay.
In Twilight you will be [b]surrounded by darkness[/b] and will have to find your way through [b]15 new levels[/b] in this new Extra. Fit with [b]gravity inverters[/b] and a [b]projectile that rotates your view[/b], this is a great way to show your determination whilst having some fun!

[u][b]Player Customisation[/b][/u]
Upon [b]clicking yourself[/b] in the main menu you will be transported to a [b]new customisation screen[/b] with [b]20 colours[/b] to pick from.
You will also unlock an [b]animated skin[/b] for beating [b]Evasion[/b] which can make your playthrough much more lively!

[u][b]Other[/b][/u]
 - Red laser eyes now shoot faster spikes
 - Red laser eyes no longer have a projectile offset
